I don't think a time limit alone is sufficient - people could simply park accounts for a couple of weeks without contributing, then use them for downvoting. If we're concerned with brigading, it's more about the total number of accounts that can hit a single comment/submission than the number of times each of those accounts can downvote per day. If people wanted/needed to downvote more than 10 times, they would just create alts and swap to one of them when they'd reached the limit (again, not needing to actually contribute with their alts to earn that right).

As it stands, a lot of us upvote opinions we disagree with (instead of downvoting them) so long as the poster has put effort/thought into their comment. Sure there are some who use their downvotes as a 'disagree' button, but I think there's just as many people going around offering upvotes to counter this behaviour.
